package.name: blueboat_replanner
package.description: Aspect-aware replanner for the BlueBoat side-scan survey (thesis deliverable D6). Reads only the belief map as target evidence and changes the path being followed through Control's live path update (/blueboat/update_path). Generates every survey condition (single pass, two-pass orthogonal, append-on-completion, informative) through one coverage generator and one executor. The core is ROS-free and deterministic.
